title: Yellow Roasted Venezuelan Sevaiiya Noodles
description: A light and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring roasted sevaiiya noodles, perfect for a date night, and is onion and garlic free. This recipe is a unique blend of Venezuelan cuisine with Indian sevaiiya noodles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the sevaiiya noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil and spice mixture.
Spread the noodles on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
In a separate pan, saute the grated carrots and diced yellow bell pepper until tender.
Combine the roasted noodles, sauteed carrots and bell pepper, and chopped cilantro in a large serving dish.
Toss to combine and serve hot.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
